title: OnlyTPNext
description: Teleport anywhere or to anyone with a single command—no cheats, no client mods.
body:
🚀 Release v1.0.0 – onlytpnext

A lightweight, server-side only Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets anyone teleport—no cheats required!    
Inspired by Onlytp, but not built from Onlytp.

---

✨ Key Features

- ✅ No OP needed – every player can use it without elevated permissions  
- ✅ One command – `/otp <x> <y> <z>` or `/otp <player>`  
- ✅ Server-side only – clients don’t need to install anything; just drop into `mods`  
- ✅ Zero extra deps – works with Fabric API alone

---

🎯 Usage Examples

```bash
# Teleport to coordinates (100, 64, -200)
/otp 100 64 -200

# Teleport to player Steve
/otp Steve
```

---

📦 Installation

1. Download `onlytpnext-1.0.0.jar`  
2. Place it in the server’s `mods` folder  
3. Start or restart the server—start teleporting!

---

🔧 Technical Details

Minecraft	1.21.1	  
Fabric Loader	≥0.17.0	  
Fabric API	0.116.4+1.21.1
